description: The file defines the class Vtiger_PDF_Generator responsible for generating PDF documents in the vtiger CRM system. It manages pages, headers, footers, and integrates with TCPDF library for PDF creation.

classes.name: Vtiger_PDF_Generator
classes.description: Class responsible for generating and managing PDF pages, headers, footers, and content using TCPDF library within vtiger CRM.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the PDF generator with a new TCPDF object and disables default header and footer printing.

methods.name: setHeaderViewer
methods.description: Sets the viewer component responsible for the header content.

methods.name: setFooterViewer
methods.description: Sets the viewer component responsible for the footer content.

methods.name: setContentViewer
methods.description: Sets the viewer component responsible for the main content.

methods.name: setPagerViewer
methods.description: Sets the viewer component responsible for the pager.

methods.name: onLastPage
methods.description: Indicates if the current page is the last page.

methods.name: onFirstPage
methods.description: Indicates if the current page is the first page.

methods.name: getTotalWidth
methods.description: Returns the total width of the current page.

methods.name: getTotalHeight
methods.description: Returns the total height of the current page.

methods.name: createLastPage
methods.description: Creates and adds the last page with footer if needed, returning true if created.

methods.name: createPage
methods.description: Creates a new page, handling headers, footers, and content frames based on the page type.

methods.name: generate
methods.description: Outputs the generated PDF document with a specified filename and mode.

methods.name: getImageSize
methods.description: Retrieves the size of an image file, handling errors and fallback dimensions.
